power.neoorigins.kraken_deep_current.des: Na-egwu mmiri ngwa ngwa karịa onye ọ bụla bi n'elu.
power.neoorigins.kraken_pressure_armor.d: Mgbochi na-adịgide adịgide I - nzuzo miri emi nke e wuru maka ịzọpịa nrụgide.
power.neoorigins.kraken_regen_in_water.d: Na-agwọkwa 2 HP kwa nkeji mgbe ọ nọ na mmiri.
power.neoorigins.kraken_beached.name: N'akụkụ osimiri
power.neoorigins.kraken_beached.descript: Na-eji nwayọọ nwayọọ 30% na ala - ewughị maka ịga ije.
Na-emebi 1 n'otu nkeji mgbe ìhè anyanwụ na-ekpuchi ya.
Kpọọ onye nlekọta ka ọ lụọ gị ọgụ. Max 2 ozugbo. Ọ na-efu isi 5. 20-nkeji oyi. Ị ga-emebi 1 ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nwụọ na ọgụ.
power.neoorigins.kraken_massive.name: Nnukwu
power.neoorigins.kraken_massive.descript: 30% buru ibu karịa onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.kraken_dries_out.name: Na-akpọnwụ
power.neoorigins.kraken_dries_out.descri: Ikuku na-ada mgbe ị na-apụ na mmiri: elu dị ogologo karịa ma ị kubie ume. Mmiri ozuzo, ite mmiri, iku ume mmiri ma ọ bụ ọwa mmiri na-arụ ọrụ dị nso na-egbochi ya.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_summon_guardian: Kpọọ onye nlekọta ka ọ lụọ gị ọgụ. Max 2 ozugbo. Ọ na-efu isi 5. 20-nkeji oyi. Ị ga-emebi 1 ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nwụọ na ọgụ.
origins.neoorigins.warden.name: Onye nlekọta
origins.neoorigins.warden.description: Amụrụ site n'ọchịchịrị miri emi - na-ahụ ụwa site na ịma jijiji, na-ewepụta mmụba nke ụda na nso, wee daa dị ka ebule na-eti ihe. Ịkụ osisi na mgbu site na ìhè anyanwụ.
power.neoorigins.warden_sonic_boom.name: Mgbawa ụda
power.neoorigins.warden_sonic_boom.descr: Na-agbawa ụda ụda ụda na-agbawa obi (mmebi anwansi 8 + Slowness III na mpaghara mgbochi 10). Na-efu 4 ume. 20-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.warden_echolocation.des: Ihe ndị dị ndụ dị nso na-egbuke egbuke, na-ahụ anya ọbụna site na mgbidi.
power.neoorigins.warden_tremor_sense.des: Mmetụta ihe dị anya - sekọnd abụọ ọ bụla, ihe ọ bụla n'ime 24 blocks na-egbuke egbuke maka 3 sekọnd.
power.neoorigins.warden_strength.name: Ike miri emi
power.neoorigins.warden_ancient_hide.des: Nguzogide na-adịgide adịgide nke Abụọ - anụ ahụ mbụ na nnukwu akpụ akpụ na-eleghara ọtụtụ mmebi anya.
power.neoorigins.warden_night_vision.des: Na-aghọta ụwa site na ịma jijiji - ọchịchịrị adịghị mkpa.
power.neoorigins.warden_hulking_frame.de: 15% buru ibu karịa onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị.
Na-emebi 1 n'otu nkeji mgbe ìhè anyanwụ na-ekpuchi ya.
power.neoorigins.warden_lumbering.name: Ịkụ osisi
power.neoorigins.warden_lumbering.descri: Na-eme 30% nwayọ karịa ka nkịtị - ike na-agbawa obi ma na-ebupụta ihe.
origins.neoorigins.dwarf.name: Dwarf
origins.neoorigins.dwarf.description: Onye omenkà siri ike nke dị n'okpuru ala - kọmpat, onye agha na-agwụ ike, na-agwụkwa ike n'ọkpụ akpụ, mana ọ dị mkpụmkpụ na nwayọ n'elu.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_compact_frame.des: 80% nha nke onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị - dabara na oghere ndị siri ike.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stout_constitutio: Nguzogide na-adịgide adịgide I - akwara na ọkpụkpụ siri ike adịghị amịpụta ngwa ngwa.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_darkvision.name: Ọhụụ n'ọchịchịrị
power.neoorigins.dwarf_darkvision.descri: Nwere ike ịhụ n'ụzọ doro anya na mkpokọta ọchịchịrị - a ndụ n'okpuruala. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.dwarf_sturdy_legs.name: Ụkwụ siri ike
power.neoorigins.dwarf_sturdy_legs.descr: Na-emegharị 15% nwayọ - obere ụkwụ mana kwụ ọtọ.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stonecunning.name: Amamihe nkume
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stonecunning.desc: Na-agbaji 25% ngwa ngwa - ejiri aka mee ihe ọ bụla.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_short_reach.name: Ogwe aka dị mkpụmkpụ
power.neoorigins.dwarf_short_reach.descr: Mgbochi mmekọrịta dị nso belatara site na 0.5 - ogwe aka dị mkpụmkpụ, njide siri ike.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_mining_hunger.des: Na-eji 25% obere agụụ site na mmemme niile - nke e wuru maka ntachi obi.
Nyere igwe dwarven pickaxe (Unbreaking II, Efficiency I) mgbe ịhọrọ mmalite a.
origins.neoorigins.breeze.name: Ikuku
origins.neoorigins.breeze.description: Ihe e kere eke nke ifufe a mụrụ na Ụlọ Ọnwụnwa - ngwa ngwa, ikuku na-ebufe, na ngwa ngwa na gusts, ma ìhè na adịghị ike.
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_charge.name: Ikuku ikuku
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_charge.desc: Na-ewepụta ikuku nke na-akụda ndị iro azụ. 5-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_dash.name: Ikuku ikuku
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_dash.descri: Na-atụ n'ihu n'oké ifufe. 4-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.breeze_no_fall_damage.d: Enwere ike ịgbagharị: ifufe na-ejide gị ka ị na-ada. Na ndabara - gbanye ya na igodo nka iji nweta ihe egwu dị egwu.
power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.name: Nkwalite
power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.descr: Enwere ike ịgbagharị: ndị na-agba ọsọ na-ebuli elu elu (Jump Boost II). Agbanye na ndabara - jiri igodo nka gbanyụọ ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ ịdị elu elu.
power.neoorigins.breeze_speed_boost.name: Ifufe ọdụ
power.neoorigins.breeze_speed_boost.desc: Na-eme 15% ngwa ngwa - ikuku na-ebuga gị n'ihu.
power.neoorigins.breeze_reduced_health.d: -4 obi (-8 max HP). Otu ikuku bụ anụ ahụ ma ọlị.
power.neoorigins.breeze_light_frame.name: Igwe ọkụ
power.neoorigins.breeze_light_frame.desc: 90% nha nke onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị - ọkụ na ikuku.
origins.neoorigins.vampire.name: Vampire
origins.neoorigins.vampire.description: Onye na-eri anụ anwụghị anwụ nke abalị - ngwa ngwa, dị ike, na agụụ ebighị ebi. Ìhè anyanwụ bụ ihe mgbu, mmiri na-ere ọkụ, na naanị anụ ahụ dị ndụ na-akwado gị.
power.neoorigins.vampire_entity_group.de: Nkewa dị ka anwụghị anwụ. Ahụ ike ozugbo merụọ ya, mmerụ ngwa ngwa gwọọ ya, nsi anaghị emetụta ya.
power.neoorigins.vampire_water_breathing: Ọ dịghị mkpa iku ume. Nwere ike ịdị ndụ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi n'okpuru mmiri.
power.neoorigins.vampire_night_vision.de: Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.vampire_speed_boost.des: Na-eme 15% ngwa ngwa - nhụsianya na ìhè ọnwa.
power.neoorigins.vampire_daylight_damage: Na-enweta ọkụ ma na-emebi 2 kwa nkeji na ìhè anyanwụ kpọmkwem.
power.neoorigins.vampire_slow_regen.name: Ozu Dị Mkpa
power.neoorigins.vampire_slow_regen.desc: A na-ebelata nrụpụta ahụike eke ka ọ bụrụ 40% nke nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.vampire_food_restrictio: Enwere ike iri naanị anụ raw, anụ rere ure, na anya ududo.
power.neoorigins.vampire_blood_diet_bonu: Anụ chara acha na nke rere ure na-azụ gị dị ka a ga-esi esi ya ọhụrụ.
Na-ewere mmebi 1 kwa nkeji mgbe ọ nọ na mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo.
origins.neoorigins.monster_tamer.name: Nnukwu anụ ọkụkọ
origins.neoorigins.monster_tamer.descrip: Onye na-ejide anụ ọhịa na-adịghị atụ egwu nke na-ehulata ìgwè ndị iro na-eme uche ha. Naanị ha bụ ndị na-esighị ike, ma n'ịbụ ndị na-eguzosi ike n'ihe n'akụkụ ha, ha bụ ike a ga-eji na-agụkọ ọnụ.
power.neoorigins.tamer_tame_mob.name: Na-achị
power.neoorigins.tamer_tame_mob.descript: Lelee otu ndị na-eme ihe ike ma mee ka ọ gbadaa n'uche gị. Ọ ga-eso gị wee chebe gị. Ndị ọgba aghara 4 kacha elu. Ọ na-efu 3 isi. 10-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.tamer_command_pack.name: Dị ka 'em
power.neoorigins.tamer_command_pack.desc: Lelee ihe mgbaru ọsọ wee rụọ ọrụ iji nye mkpọ gị niile iwu ka ha wakpo ya. 2-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.tamer_horde_regen.name: Njikọ otu
power.neoorigins.tamer_horde_regen.descr: Ndị otu gị a zụrụ azụ na-eji nwayọọ nwayọọ na-emegharị 1 HP kwa sekọnd isii mgbe ha na-alụ ọgụ.
power.neoorigins.tamer_weak_alone.name: Nanị adịghị ike
power.neoorigins.tamer_weak_alone.descri: Mebie mmebi melee 25% dị ala - ị dabere na mkpọ gị ịlụ ọgụ.
power.neoorigins.tamer_hunger_drain.name: Nye ngwugwu ahụ nri
power.neoorigins.tamer_hunger_drain.desc: Agụụ na-ewepụ 50% ngwa ngwa site na nsogbu nke idowe njikọ gị.
power.neoorigins.tame_mob.not_hostile: Enwere ike ịzụ ndị na-eme ihe ike naanị!
power.neoorigins.tame_mob.no_resource: Enweghị ike zuru oke iji zụọ!
power.neoorigins.mount.no_target: Ọ nweghị ihe dị na oke.
power.neoorigins.mount.not_allowed_playe: Ike a enweghị ike ịche ndị egwuregwu.
power.neoorigins.mount.not_allowed_mobs: Ike a enweghị ike ịchụ ndị na-eme ihe ike.
power.neoorigins.mount.boss_blocked: Enweghị ike ịwụli ìgwè ndị isi!
power.neoorigins.mount.already_ridden: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ enweelarị onye na-agba!
power.neoorigins.command_pack.no_pack: Ị nweghị ndị a zụrụ azụ!
power.neoorigins.command_pack.success: Ndị otu %s nyere iwu ka ha wakpo %s!
origins.neoorigins.earth_mage.name: Ụwa Mage
origins.neoorigins.earth_mage.descriptio: Onye na-ahụ maka geomancer siri ike nke na-akụda ala ka ọ gbawaa ndị iro wee wulite mgbidi nkume na mmegharị ahụ. Nke a na-apụghị ibugharị dị ka ugwu, ma ụwa na-ejide ha nso - mmiri na ebe dị elu abụghị enyi ha.
Slam ụwa, na-emebi mmebi 6 ma na-akụghachi ihe niile dị nso. Ọ na-efu 3 mana. 6-nke abụọ cooldown.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_stone_wall.d: Debe ihe mgbochi okwute ebe ị na-achọ. 2-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_stonecunning: Nkume m na ore 50% ngwa ngwa.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_rooted.name: Gbanyere mkpọrọgwụ
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_rooted.descr: Were 50% obere ịkụ azụ - guzosie ike dị ka akwa akwa.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_heavy.name: Arọ
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_heavy.descri: Enweghị ike igwu mmiri - ị na-emikpu dị ka nkume.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_earthbound.d: Were mmebi ọdịda 50% karịa. Ala na-eweghachi nke ya.
origins.neoorigins.water_mage.name: Mmiri Mage
